title: Invisible Man
author: Ralph Ellison
summary: A nameless young Black man moves from a Southern college to Harlem, joining one organisation after another that promises purpose. He narrates from a hidden underground room, explaining how he became invisible.
readIf: you like ambitious novels that mix satire, nightmare and jazz-like narration to examine identity.
skipIf: you want a straightforward plot; it is episodic, symbolic and often surreal.

pairings.reason: A more direct, tragic and naturalistic novel about the same American problem.
Another formally daring novel that uses surreal elements to confront American history.
Shares the bitter, absurd comedy of an individual trapped in systems that make no sense.
